I didn't dig a lot into it, but they seem to mention a "loose mode".

> By default, when using modules with Babel a non-enumerable \_\_esModule property is exported. This is done through the use of Object.defineProperty which is unsupported in IE8 and below. A workaround for this is to enable loose mode - modules.

I thought that was enough to support IE8 but maybe I don't see get all of it.
